scope: B1-X2 Enemy Hit Reaction: health-loss-driven, throttled Sprite self_modulate feedback in Mob.gd. No damage, collision, death, drop, TCE, Camera, or Audio semantic changes.

entities.expected_runtime_effect: When Mob health decreases, the AnimatedSprite receives a short self_modulate flash at most once per 160ms, then returns to white. Existing status Sprite.modulate remains independent.

patches.new_text:
onready var pathing = $PathingController
var velocity

# k2-hit-reaction (B1-X2): visual-only health-loss feedback state
var _hit_reaction_previous_health = -1.0
var _hit_reaction_remaining = 0.0
var _hit_reaction_cooldown = 0.0
const HIT_REACTION_DURATION = 0.06
const HIT_REACTION_MIN_INTERVAL = 0.16
const HIT_REACTION_COLOR = Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.62, 1.0)

patches.old_text:
func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void :
				last_check_time += delta * (0.5 + 0.5 * randf())

patches.new_text:
func _on_update_healthbar():
				var current_health = stats.health
				if _hit_reaction_previous_health >= 0.0 and current_health < _hit_reaction_previous_health and _hit_reaction_cooldown <= 0.0:
								$SpriteContainer / Sprite.self_modulate = HIT_REACTION_COLOR
								_hit_reaction_remaining = HIT_REACTION_DURATION
								_hit_reaction_cooldown = HIT_REACTION_MIN_INTERVAL
				_hit_reaction_previous_health = current_health
				status_bar.update_healthbar(stats)

not_proven: Remote C0 confirms the lack of a Mob direct-hit signal and exact Mob.gd preimage. v0.1 has not yet passed local canonical build, S0/S1/S2/S4, or Combat S5; direct-vs-DoT and crit/heavy differentiation remain future work.
